prompt.text:
Implement an archive-entry service over an injected repository. Export `ArchiveEntry`, `ArchiveDraft`, `ArchiveRepository`, `ServiceResult<T>`, and `ArchiveService`. The class must expose `list()`, `find(id)`, `create(draft)`, and `createMany(drafts)`. A valid draft has non-empty `id` and `title`, a non-negative integer `rank`, and only non-empty tags. Invalid input returns `{ ok: false, reason: "invalid" }` without calling the repository. A missing entry returns reason `not_found`; repository exceptions return `storage_error`. Empty batches succeed without a repository call. Batch order must be preserved. All inputs, repository results, and returned values must be copied so mutable arrays or records are not aliased.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
